text:
Priority: urgent
Tell the reader, planner and critic the banned words, as the producer brief already does

Readings keep being refused for a banned boundary word: qfqs on 2026-10-30 and 17c3 three times on 2026-10-31, each for a word naming who runs Athena, picked up from the repository's own folder and files. Only the producer brief has the 'Words you must not write' section (`banned_words_section` in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs, D73); the reader, planner and critic briefs do not, so their agents cannot know the list until a refusal names it.

Add the same section to `reader_brief`, `planner_brief` and `critic_brief`, built from the same `boundary_words` and `boundary_fragments`, without the producer-only scan instruction. Keep each brief within its size test.

Acceptance:
- Tests show the reader, planner and critic briefs each contain every word from `boundary_words` in that section, and the producer brief is unchanged.
- The brief size tests still pass.
- fmt, clippy with -D warnings and the test suite pass; CHANGELOG.md has an entry.
Files: crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs, CHANGELOG.md
